topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Isn't it a delightful twist of fate? I never could have anticipated that the friend I've known only through the glow of a screen shares the very air I breathe in this sprawling city. It's as if the world has decided to shrink just enough to bring us closer. I find myself looking forward to the moments we can share, the laughter that won’t be delayed by lags or buffered by distance. Real connections, it seems, are the treasures that technology can hint at but can never fully contain.
